thread:
sophie: FYI — LumaAI reached out to onboard Luma-7b-q (4-bit quantized) into our marketplace. They want a dedicated listing + co-marketing. Key asks: redistribution of quantized weights, hardware performance badge (H100, A100), and a joint announcement. Need legal + eng signoff. Thoughts?

marta: Can we get the model card and the exact license file? They said 'permissive' but didn't confirm redistribution of weights.

raj: Engineering notes — our runtime supports 4-bit but we need the quantization recipe and any calibration tables. Otherwise we'll have to re-run quant and that changes perf numbers. Also need to confirm no proprietary post-processing tied to the quant step. If they lock the recipe, redistribution could be blocked.

alice-legal: Quick flag: redistribution rights need to be explicit. If weights are covered by a separate grant, we need an explicit redistribution + sublicensing clause. Also I'll run an export-control checklist — we need training data provenance and any dual-use disclosures.

jordan: On marketplace ops — if redistribution is allowed we'll show a "redistributable weights" badge and list supported hardware. We'll also coordinate cloud partners (AWS/GCP) for a marketplace image. What’s the go-live target?

sophie: LumaAI asked for a Q2 end target (~May 12). They prefer joint blog + webinar. We should confirm an embargo window and partner approvals.

security-bot: preliminary artifact-scan: sample checkpoint hash provided; no prohibited content flagged. This is not legal clearance.

raj: Can they share a tiny 2k-step quantized checkpoint for perf validation? Prefer a reproducible script in a repo so we can verify numbers.

marta: I'll request: (1) full license file, (2) model card + provenance statement, (3) quantization recipe + minimal checkpoint, (4) desired announcement date. Pinged their contact.

sophie: Action items — alice-legal to confirm redistribution grant by 1768600000, raj to run perf matrix by 1768670000, marta to confirm marketing plan with Luma by 1768605000. Tentative meeting Thu 10am PT :calendar:.

jordan: I'll draft the cloud marketplace listing template and a co-marketing outline. If legal gives the green light, I'll also scope AWS marketplace slot & GCP partner review.

alice-legal: I'll draft a redistribution addendum and the export-control questionnaire. Also need to confirm license compatibility (eg. Apache/2.0) if their training code had mixed licenses. Back by EOD Tuesday.

marta: Quick update from Luma (Dave): license is BSD-3 + weights redistribution allowed. They'll send model card and recipe tonight. They proposed joint announce May 10.

sophie: May 10 might be tight for partner approvals. Let's target May 12 and keep May 10 as a soft target. Also confirm hardware badge testing scope — raj will run perf.

raj: I'll run benchmarks on H100 and A100 and return a simple table. Suggest thresholds for "H100 optimized" badge: >=2.5x fp16 baseline or >=1.8x 4-bit baseline. Open to refining.

jordan: Marketing fine with that metric. Also propose a 48h embargo after legal signoff so we can coordinate cloud partner approvals and marketplace listing windows.

alice-legal: Noted. If any export-control issues arise we may recommend deploying as Dedicated-only while we sort approvals. Will report back.

sophie: Meeting confirmed Thu 10am PT. Agenda: legal signoff, perf results, marketplace listing draft, announcement timeline. :thumbsup:

marta: I'll update this thread as docs arrive.

marta: sample packaging manifest requested from Luma (for our ingestion):

```
model_manifest:
  name: luma-7b-q
  version: "1.0"
  license: "BSD-3-Clause (weights redistribution: allowed)"
  quantization: "4-bit/lsq"
  provenance: "https://luma.ai/models/luma-7b-q/model-card.md"
  sample_checkpoint_sha256: "abc123deadbeef..."
  supported_hardware: [h100, a100]
```

sophie: OK — once we have the license + manifest + sample checkpoint we'll start perf runs and legal review.Thanks everyone.
